tests.name: Three trusted authorities initialized
Key fingerprints deterministic
Authority IDs deterministic and bound to keyring
Worker + Supervisor quorum succeeds
Worker + Verifier quorum succeeds
Supervisor + Verifier quorum succeeds
Worker alone fails with INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES
Supervisor alone fails with INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES
Verifier alone fails with INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES
Worker + Worker duplicate fails with DUPLICATE_AUTHORITY
Supervisor + Supervisor duplicate fails with DUPLICATE_AUTHORITY
Duplicate signature cannot increase threshold count
Compromised Worker cannot forge accepted evidence (A1 Defense)
Compromised Supervisor alone cannot forge accepted evidence
Compromised Verifier alone cannot forge accepted evidence
Signature substitution without changing authorityId fails
Authority substitution fails with INVALID_SIGNATURE
Cross-bundle signature reuse fails with INVALID_SIGNATURE
Provenance-root mutation fails
Bundle-ID mutation fails
Revoked authority cannot satisfy new threshold
Unknown authority fails with UNKNOWN_AUTHORITY
Historical revoked signature remains auditable
Historical bundle does not become newly acceptable after revocation
Valid quorum + invalid replay fails with REPLAY_VERIFICATION_FAILURE
Valid quorum + policy violation fails with SECURITY_POLICY_FAILURE
Valid quorum + secret leak fails with SECURITY_POLICY_FAILURE
Valid replay + insufficient quorum fails with INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES
Accepted quorum bundle archived
Insufficient quorum quarantined
Duplicate submission remains idempotent
Identity conflict does not overwrite existing bundle
Deterministic verification result across invocations
Signature ordering does not affect threshold result
Authority ordering does not affect threshold result
Phase 35 single-signature behavior preserved for legacy gateways
allowUnsignedLegacy=true remains functional
allowUnsignedLegacy=false remains fail-closed

securityProperties.name: PRODUCER_COMPROMISE_DEFENSE
securityProperties.description: An attacker possessing only WORKER_PRODUCER private key cannot produce accepted evidence.

securityProperties.name: AUTHORITY_DISTINCTNESS
securityProperties.description: Duplicate signatures from the same authorityId are deduplicated and cannot satisfy threshold.

securityProperties.name: CONJUNCTIVE_GATE_ENFORCEMENT
securityProperties.description: Quorum authorization requires simultaneous satisfaction of Threshold, Replay, Policy, and Secret-scan gates.

securityProperties.name: CANONICAL_SIGNING_PAYLOAD_BINDING
securityProperties.description: Signatures bind immutably to bundleId, provenanceRoot, formatVersion, and schemaVersion.

securityProperties.name: FAIL_CLOSED_STATUS_CODES
securityProperties.description: INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITIES, DUPLICATE_AUTHORITY, UNKNOWN_AUTHORITY, REVOKED_AUTHORITY, INVALID_SIGNATURE reject deterministically.
